name: Legacy Truck Parts
old_description: When your truck is sidelined, every minute counts. Legacy Truck Parts specializes in rapid roadside delivery of premium truck parts in Las Vegas and the surrounding areas. From essential components like brake pads, alternators, and filters to hard-to-find specialty truck parts, our inventory is designed to get you back on the road fast. With our streamlined order process, you can request truck parts online or by phone, and our dedicated team will deliver directly to your location—day or night.
about:
Legacy Truck Parts operates from a facility on West Ali Baba Lane in Las Vegas, Nevada, supplying truck and trailer components to customers across the metropolitan area and into Kingman, Arizona. The company's founding year and ownership details are not publicly disclosed; it was established to serve individual owner‑operators and fleet managers who need reliable parts without delay.

The business stocks a broad range of OEM and aftermarket parts, including engine components, suspension systems, air brake and wheel parts, air springs and shocks, body and cabin items, lighting, cooling, electrical, exhaust, HVAC, and power‑train components. Inventory is sourced from recognized brands and held in a warehouse that supports same‑day roadside delivery for local customers. The company does not manufacture parts; it functions as a distributor and service provider, offering phone and online ordering with direct delivery to the vehicle's location.

Primary customers are commercial trucking fleets, independent owner‑operators, and maintenance shops in the Las Vegas region. The company also supports fleet services programs, providing scheduled parts supply and emergency roadside assistance.

Legacy Truck Parts emphasizes competitive pricing, a wide selection, and knowledgeable staff who help customers identify the correct part quickly. The company states that its commitment to quality and rapid delivery—day or night—was driven by the recognition that downtime costs fleets money, and it aims to keep trucks moving with minimal interruption.

name: Legend Electronics
old_description: Our company's objective is to continually improve in all aspects of our business through a customer-oriented quality management system. We are committed to ensuring that this policy is understood and implemented throughout the organization.
about:
Legend Electronics is an independent stocking distributor of electronic components based in Hawthorne, New York. Founded in 1991, the company has operated as a global sourcing partner for new and obsolete semiconductors, integrated circuits, relays, connectors, switches, and Mil-Spec components.

The company maintains a live inventory of 34,422 part numbers across 40,127 lots, with each lot listed separately including date code, country of origin, packaging, and RoHS status. Beyond stocking, Legend Electronics provides shortage management, cost reduction, excess inventory management, MRP support, last-time-buy fulfillment, and end-of-life product sourcing. Its quality management system is certified to ISO 9001:2015.

Legend Electronics serves original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), contract manufacturers, and repair depots across the electronics industry, including aerospace and defense customers requiring Mil-Spec components. The company emphasizes personal service, assigning each customer a dedicated sales contact to manage requirements from bill-of-materials support to emergency shortages.

The business was built on the ability to source hard-to-find, allocated, or discontinued components quickly, leveraging global supplier relationships and a lot-level traceability system that gives buyers full visibility into what ships.

name: Levison Enterprises
old_description: When your industrial electronics, devices, or power supplies fail, you need to find an electronics repair solution quickly. Levison Enterprises specializes in electronic repair services tailored to fix current and legacy electronic projects and keep your operations running smoothly. Even when original PCB or Gerber files are unavailable, our experienced engineering team can diagnose and repair issues.
about:
Levison Enterprises operates from a 15,000-square-foot facility in Millbury, Ohio, where it has been based since 2014. The company began as an AC plasma display manufacturer with in-house electronic manufacturing capabilities. As printed circuit board technology advanced and demand for plasma displays waned, the engineering team pivoted to become a full-service electronic contract manufacturer and sub-assembly provider. The business is organized as a limited liability company led by President David M. Levison.

The company provides turnkey electronic manufacturing services including printed circuit board assembly, cable and wire harness fabrication, electronic repair and diagnostics, PCB design and engineering, rapid prototyping, and legacy product repair with reverse engineering. Its facility features ESD-safe epoxy flooring, semi-truck access, and on-site engineering and supply chain management. Levison holds AS9100, ISO 9001, and ISO 13485 certifications through NSF-ISR, is ITAR registered, and complies with IPC and J-STD standards while working toward CMMC compliance.

Levison serves military and aerospace, medical device, food safety, industrial, and defense customers. Case studies reference Seagate Mobile Security Solutions for security systems, EPI Global for legacy displays dating to the 1960s, and international clients who value faster shipping and engineering responsiveness. The company also supports design engineers who need a manufacturing partner for prototype through production runs.

Levison emphasizes a culture of continuous improvement, targeting 100% quality, on-time delivery, and customer satisfaction. Its differentiators include a vetted domestic supply chain with counterfeit-part mitigation, on-site engineers for real-time problem solving, PFMEA-driven process controls, and a single-project-manager model for turnkey programs. The company was founded to bridge the gap between design and reliable domestic manufacturing, especially for regulated industries.

name: Leviton
old_description: Manufactures electrical wiring devices including switches, sockets, and outlets.
about:
Leviton, headquartered in Melville, New York, was founded in 1906. Over more than a century, the company has grown into a manufacturer of electrical wiring devices, lighting controls, data networking infrastructure, and energy management solutions.

The product portfolio spans switches, dimmers, outlets, and lighting controls for residential and commercial use; TrueArc AFCI breakers designed to reduce nuisance tripping; fusion splicing solutions for fiber optic installations; the My Leviton app for unified smart home control of lighting, load management, and EV charging; Series 2500 utility submeters with tool-free connectors; Leviton Load Centers for modern electrical panels; data center cabling and infrastructure; Arc-Arrest switch-rated pin and sleeve devices; and dockside power accessories. Recent investments include a $100 million global capital expansion for AI and smart building network infrastructure.

Leviton serves residential homeowners, electrical contractors, data center operators, utility companies, and marine dock operators. Its solutions appear in new home construction, commercial buildings, high-density data centers, utility submetering programs, and shore power installations.

The company emphasizes a legacy of quality, safety, and forward-thinking design, citing engineering, real-world insight, and customer-focused partnership as differentiators. Leviton also states a commitment to responsible practices and a goal of company-wide carbon neutrality by 2030.

name: Lewis Woodshop LLC
old_description: Lewis Woodshop is a custom woodshop located in rural Essex, Vermont that produces fine, heirloom-quality furniture. Using locally sourced materials, David builds each piece from hand, incorporating various styles, including Shaker, Japanese Kumiko and modern. Whether you want furniture that evokes the warmth and sophistication of Europe, the precision and architecture of Asuka-era Japan, or the rugged authenticity of Vermont, Lewis Woodshop has all your needs covered.
about:
Lewis Woodshop LLC operates from a 1,000-square-foot workshop in Essex, Vermont, a rural town about 20 minutes from Burlington. The business was founded by David Lewis, who grew up in Lutherville, Maryland, and developed a passion for fine furniture making while attending the Vermont Woodworking School. After completing his training, Lewis established his own shop, building each piece by hand using locally sourced, sustainably harvested lumber.

The shop produces custom furniture including tables, dressers, beds, chests, chairs, and decorative pieces such as Kumiko lanterns. Each item is crafted individually using a blend of power tools and traditional hand tools—chisels, saws, and sanders—allowing for both precision and artistic detail. The workshop spans roughly 1,000 square feet and is run solely by Lewis, who oversees every step from material selection to final finish.

Lewis Woodshop serves private clients seeking bespoke, heirloom-quality furniture for residential settings. Past commissions have included Shaker-style hall tables, Kumiko-adorned end tables and lanterns, pencil-post beds, and chests of drawers. The shop also collaborates with clients on one-of-a-kind designs, guiding them through wood selection, style, and design choices.

The company emphasizes a commitment to craftsmanship and sustainability. Lewis sources lumber that is sustainably grown and responsibly harvested, and he describes his work as a pursuit of harmony between utility and aesthetics, resulting in pieces that are considered functional works of art.

name: Lexco Cable Manufacturing
old_description: Lexco specializes in supplying steel cable ends and wire rope cable ends for OEMs and industrial buyers who require precise, load-rated termination solutions. Each fitting is selected or manufactured based on application-specific requirements including load capacity, environment, connection type, and installation method.
about:
Lexco Cable Manufacturing operates from Norridge, Illinois, where it has been a family-owned business since its founding in 1974. The company began as a manufacturer of wire rope, cable, and bungee cord assemblies, serving both standard and custom applications.

Today, Lexco fabricates custom wire rope assemblies, cable assemblies, bungee cord assemblies, push-pull controls, and architectural cable railings. Its capabilities include custom cut-to-length services, crimping, swaging, and engineering support, all backed by ISO 9001-certified quality processes. The shop handles small- to high-volume production with flexible order quantities and low minimums.

The company serves military, OEM, MRO, distributor, and contractor markets, as well as specialized sectors such as aerospace and defense, fitness, and agriculture. Customers include general contractors and aftermarket sellers who require load-rated termination solutions tailored to specific load capacities, environments, and installation methods.

Lexco differentiates itself by combining custom assembly fabrication with practical production support, offering quick turnarounds, application-specific engineering, and a CAGE code (1VXG5) for government contracting. Its 50-year track record reflects ongoing investment in people, processes, and capabilities.

name: Lima Sheet Metal
old_description: Family-owned and operated since 1974, serving Ohio with quality metal
about:
Lima Sheet Metal has operated from Lima, Ohio since 1974, when founder Michael Ray Emerick opened a shop to serve the local community with integrity and quality craftsmanship. The business remains family-owned and women-owned, now in its third generation under the leadership of CEO Anne Emerick, President James "Bo" Emerick, and General Manager Steve Emerick.

The company provides full-service sheet metal fabrication, structural steel work, ventilation and ductwork, and material handling equipment. Its in-house machine shop handles CNC and manual machining, MIG, TIG, and stick welding, press brake forming up to 12 feet, shearing, and plasma cutting. Capabilities extend to confined space entry services, on-site installation, and emergency welding repair, covering projects from custom prototypes to production runs.

Lima Sheet Metal serves industrial, commercial, and municipal clients throughout Ohio, with specialized expertise for the food and restaurant industries. Typical projects include custom guarding, drip pans, electrical enclosures, roofing and flashing, railing and stair systems, monorail and production line structures, canopy hoods, production carts, storage racks, and conveyors.

The founder's original vision — genuine care for every customer and hands-on quality — still drives the operation. The company emphasizes complete in-house control from design to installation, fast turnaround with quotes within 24 hours, and a safety-first approach backed by certified confined space technicians.

name: Lincare
old_description: REMsafe SLEEP®, one of our family of businesses and a leading provider of sleep apnea solutions, has announced a new business relationship with TCW, a leading warehousing and distribution company. This relationship will provide offer TCW's fleet of 500 drivers with state-of-the-art sleep apnea treatment.
about:
Lincare is headquartered in Rolla, Missouri, and operates as a national provider of in-home respiratory care and durable medical equipment. The company delivers services directly to patients' homes as well as to nursing homes and long-term care facilities across the United States.

The company's core offerings span home oxygen therapy (stationary and portable), sleep apnea treatment with CPAP and bilevel PAP devices, nebulizer therapy for conditions such as COPD and asthma, and home INR testing for warfarin patients. Lincare also provides enteral nutrition support with trained dietitians, high-frequency chest wall oscillation therapy, powered mobility equipment including electric wheelchairs and scooters, pediatric respiratory services, pharmacy delivery, speech-generating devices, tracheostomy and suction management, and both invasive and non-invasive home ventilator care. Digital tools such as the VentCircle™ mobile app and a secure patient portal support supply ordering, usage tracking, and account management.

Lincare serves individuals with chronic respiratory conditions, sleep disorders, and mobility limitations, as well as institutional customers such as long-term care facilities. A noted business relationship includes providing sleep apnea treatment to the 500-driver fleet of warehousing and distribution company TCW through its REMsafe SLEEP® family of businesses. The company also supports Medicare beneficiaries and offers out-of-pocket options for services not covered by insurance.

Lincare states its mission is to set the standard for excellence in home respiratory care, aiming to enable patients with chronic conditions to remain engaged in life. Differentiators highlighted by the company include complimentary programs such as CareCheck™ for COPD early intervention, HeartSteps® for congestive heart failure management, and SleepEaze™ for sleep disorder education and adherence support.

name: Linear Fine Woodworking
old_description: Linear Fine Woodworking provides beautiful custom-built cabinetry and architectural millwork to areas like Phoenix and Scottsdale Arizona as well as the greater Southwest. Each Linear Fine Woodworking creation is a work of art crafted and custom-built just for you. Whether it’s custom designed kitchen cabinetry, a wall unit, home theatre unit, or office furniture, innovation in design and woodworking is a hallmark of Linear Fine Woodworking products.
about:
Linear Fine Woodworking operates from Phoenix, Arizona, where it has been designing and building custom cabinetry, furniture, and architectural millwork for more than three decades. The company serves clients across Phoenix, Scottsdale, and the broader Southwest region.

The shop produces custom cabinetry, architectural millwork, and furniture for residential and commercial projects. A distinctive capability is the in-house production of veneer panels from rough-cut flitches, a process that yields uniformly stable panels and expands design possibilities. The team works with exotic veneers, solid woods, glass, lighting, cabling, and specialized hardware to create pieces that blend function with sculpture.

Projects range from kitchen cabinetry and wall units to home theater installations and office furniture. The company works directly with homeowners, designers, and contractors on both residential and commercial woodworking projects throughout the Southwest.

Linear Fine Woodworking emphasizes its combined team experience of over 350 years and its rare in-house veneer panel manufacturing as core differentiators. The firm was founded on the goal of merging custom furniture and cabinetry with fine art, a philosophy that continues to guide its approach.
